scientific_integrity: Constructive necessity-and-sufficiency proof. Exhaustive d=1,2 finite tests and independent right-translation rank checks; no independent mathematical audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Full automorphism-group classification is for core quandles on (Z/4Z)^d with d>=1, not arbitrary even dihedral products. Historic priority is conditional on inspected literature. Finite tests corroborate but do not prove the all-dimensional theorem. The correction applies specifically to the published inner-group order in Corollary 5.5 for d>=2. Hou (2011) asserts a general Alexander-quandle automorphism theorem, whose full text could not be compared; this creates a significant unresolved implication/priority risk.
title: Automorphisms and inner symmetries of \(4\)-torsion Takasaki quandles
